About the scheme

North West Melanoma brings together melanoma researchers across the region. This scheme is jointly funded by North West Cancer Research and the universities of Lancaster, Manchester and Liverpool. Funders track its outcomes, so we ask for a short report after each visit.

Who can apply

Early career researchers with an interest in melanoma research, applying with a host or co-applicant. PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and new principal investigators are prioritised. Lead applicants and host groups must be based in North West England or North Wales.

What it funds

Short visits up to £1,000 in total, including travel, accommodation, subsistence and consumables.

Why it matters

Research that benefits people affected by cancer across North West England and North Wales.

How to apply

Download the form, plan your visit with a partner group, then send your application to us.

  1. Download the application form

    It covers the applicants, the visit and collaboration, expected outputs, costs and reporting.

  2. Name your partner and plan the visit

    Tell us which groups or labs you will work with, the dates, and what each partner will contribute.

  3. Email your completed form

    Send it to nw-melanoma@lancaster.ac.uk by 18 December 2026.

What we ask in return

Because this scheme is jointly funded by North West Cancer Research and the universities of Lancaster, Manchester and Liverpool, successful applicants agree to:

  • Submit a short, one-page end-of-visit report within four weeks of returning.
  • Reply to brief annual requests for updates on outputs, such as publications, grants or new collaborations, for up to five years.
  • Acknowledge North West Cancer Research and North West Melanoma in any resulting outputs.
  • Allow the award and its outputs to be shared with North West Cancer Research for reporting, including via Researchfish.
